name: Doki-Doki Beach ~Munasawagi no Yokan~
original_name: どきどきビーチ ～胸騒ぎの予感～
source:
Main character attends private boys school. At summer he gets a part-time job of a guard on the beach. Summer experience awaits! And he already meets cute girl Rina Matsubara there and swears to capture her heart.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公就读私立男子学校。暑假期间，他在海滩找到一份救生员的兼职，等待着他的将是难忘的夏日经历！在那里，他遇见了可爱的松原里奈，并发誓要赢得她的芳心。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-september-2003-crosschannel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
